Subject: CAIQ deep-dive request and preferred log windows

Hi Neha,

Thanks for taking this — CedarPeak's compliance team wants to schedule a focused CAIQ/SIG deep-dive before we start the formal evidence handoff. We have two main asks for the call: a) walk us through how Redwood maps CAIQ controls to real artifacts (where we should look in the console/exports), and b) confirm which log windows and sample exports you can provide for our auditor (PrismAudit).

Ideal dates: Dec 21 or Dec 22 morning PT. We also attached our draft CAIQ table (cedarpeak_caiq_request_v1.pdf) with a few clarifying questions inline. On logs: our auditor needs 7-day rolling samples and a 30-day retention statement. Can you confirm available sample formats and any time constraints for pulling exports?

Cc'ing Samir (security ops) and PrismAudit for visibility.

Thanks,
Alicia Ramos
Head of Security
CedarPeak Health

Hi Alicia — thanks for the context and the CAIQ draft. We can absolutely do a targeted walk-through and confirm log sample formats. Quick notes up front:

- We can map CAIQ controls to artifacts during the call and share a post-call mapping doc.
- Log exports: we can produce JSON and compressed CSV exports for the following windows: ad-hoc 7-day contiguous samples and a system-level 30-day retention summary. For full raw KV/trace exports there are VPC/Private deployment constraints — we'll clarify per your environment.

I'm proposing a 45-minute session; my suggested slots (PT):
- Mon Dec 21, 09:00–09:45
- Tue Dec 22, 08:30–09:15

Marissa will run the artifact mapping portion; David will lead logs + export mechanics. If either of the proposed times works, we'll send a calendar invite and a short pre-call checklist (log_sample_instructions.md) so your team can confirm the sample ranges.

Next steps for us: please confirm a slot and the names of the auditors who will need Drive access. If your team has any particularly high-priority CAIQ rows, point them out and we'll prep specific examples.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Security Programs Manager
Redwood Inference

Alicia — adding a few specifics so expectations are clear before the call.

1) Artifact mapping: I'll show the console locations for: account management logs, auth events, model deploy change events, and KMS access logs. Post-call I will export a control-to-artifact spreadsheet.

2) Log samples: typical delivery is:
   - 7-day event sample (JSON) including timestamps, request IDs, and truncated payloads for PII protection.
   - 30-day retention summary (CSV) that lists retention policy hits and archival status.

3) Constraints: if you are on Redwood Private (VPC), we coordinate with your infra team for SFTP or signed URL access rather than pulling from the hosted console.

Please confirm the auditors' emails for Drive share. If you confirm Dec 21 09:00 PT, I'll prepare the sample extraction run tomorrow morning and drop the prep guide in the Drive folder.

Thanks — Marissa
Principal Security Engineer
Redwood Inference
